props.gloss_en: RSBG (mishna, cited by lemma): [my father's house] were accustomed... -- the elided remainder is the mishna's: to give white garments to a gentile launderer three days before Shabbat
R' Tzadok: such was the custom of Rabban Gamliel's house -- they would give white garments to the launderer three days before Shabbat
R' Tzadok: and dyed garments even on Shabbat eve
and from their words we learned that white garments are harder to launder than dyed ones
the launderer, asked what he wants for [laundering] the dyed garment: as for a white one
Abaye: one who gives a garment to a launderer should give it to him by measure and take it back from him by measure
for if it is longer, he spoiled it by stretching it, and if shorter, he spoiled it by shrinking it

supports.gloss_en: תניא, אמר רבי צדוק: כך היה מנהגו של בית רבן גמליאל... שלשה ימים קודם לשבת -- the baraita reports the same custom of the Patriarch's house
ומדבריהם למדנו -- since white garments went three days ahead and dyed ones even on Shabbat eve, white garments are harder to launder

objections.gloss_en: אמר ליה: כבר קדמוך רבנן -- the Rabbis already preceded you: they taught that white garments are harder to launder than dyed (kind tanya chosen for the baraita source; the marker is כבר קדמוך רבנן -- header)
